authoritative_for: CRM owns private case identity, exact retained intake, immutable case revisions, stage and advisory state, queued update and retry lifecycle, requester correlation and replay-safe tool receipts, deterministic library reads, and its product packaging.
not_authoritative_for: Callers and cited sources remain authoritative for supplied real-world facts, while Nucleus owns agent execution; CRM does not authorize contact, send a message, or independently prove an external connection or employment outcome.

covers: All supported public CRM CLI outcomes for case maintenance, library exploration, installation and steward operation, and product development in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, direct SQLite access, the hidden worker entry point, automatic source collection, contact delivery, direct model execution, and current runtime readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: CRM surfaces are local-user CLI and explicitly selected local-database operations; only hidden update work uses the typed Nucleus boundary and immutable crm/case-steward/1 toolset.
shared_privacy_and_retention: CRM and correlated Nucleus state may retain private case, source, prompt, advisory, and tool-result text; release bundles and provider contracts contain no user case data.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes; CLI JSON contract, database schema, requester toolset, and Nucleus protocol remain separate compatibility axes.
operational_limits: CRM has no daemon, scheduler, source crawler, contact sender, filesystem content store, or direct-Codex fallback; per-entry bounds govern each explicit operation.
